annotations.title: Verify Stripe, Shopify & RevClamp Webhook HMAC-SHA256 Signatures

description: Generate and verify canonical Stripe-Signature (t=<unix>,v1=<hex_sha256>), X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 (<base64_sha256>), and X-RevClamp-Signature (t=<unix>,v1=<hex_sha256>) headers over exact UTF-8 webhook payload bytes using crypto.timingSafeEqual and a 300-second replay window guard. Enforces a Zero-Trust guard that blocks known live/production credential patterns (sk_live_, rk_live_, non-test whsec_..., shpss_..., shpat_..., rg_live_, rc_live_, AKIA..., and PEM private keys) with -32602 LIVE_SECRET_FORBIDDEN_IN_SANDBOX. Returns structuredContent containing ok, mode, statelessEphemeralAudit, tenantId, and verification (provider, verificationMode, headerName, generatedHeader, expectedSignature, signatureValid, verificationReason, timingSafeCompared, replayWindowApplicable, timestampSec, timestampSkewSeconds, toleranceSeconds, withinReplayWindow, payloadByteLength, payloadSha256, commonIntegrationTrap). Use this tool to debug webhook signature mismatches and replay skew.

demo.description: Optional sandbox flag; uses synthetic defaults when provider, secret, or rawPayload are omitted.

provider.description: Webhook signature provider scheme to evaluate: 'stripe' (Stripe-Signature t=<sec>,v1=<hex>, default), 'shopify' (X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 Base64 raw UTF-8 HMAC), or 'revclamp' (X-RevClamp-Signature t=<sec>,v1=<hex>).

rawPayload.description: Exact unparsed UTF-8 webhook request body string (up to 16,384 chars) used to compute the canonical SHA-256 HMAC digest. Defaults to a provider-specific sample JSON event if omitted.

secret.description: Synthetic or test webhook signing secret (default: 'whsec_test_revclamp_sandbox_secret_2026', max 256 chars). Live production secrets (sk_live_, rk_live_, non-test whsec_..., shpss_..., shpat_..., rg_live_, rc_live_, AKIA..., and PEM private keys) are rejected.

signatureHeader.description: Optional supplied HTTP signature header value to verify via crypto.timingSafeEqual (e.g. 't=1760000000,v1=...' or Base64 digest, max 512 chars). Omit to run in GENERATE_AND_SELF_VERIFY mode.

timestampSec.description: Optional Unix epoch timestamp in integer seconds (valid range: 1 to 9999999999; defaults to current server Unix timestamp) used when generating or verifying timestamped Stripe/RevClamp headers.

toleranceSec.description: Optional replay window tolerance in integer seconds (valid range: 1 to 3600, default: 300).

name: revclamp_verify_webhook_signature
title: Verify Stripe, Shopify & RevClamp Webhook HMAC-SHA256 Signatures
